title: What will Donald Trump say during midterm rally in Chillicothe, Ohio originally scheduled for October 28, 2026? Deport / Deported / Deportation
rules:
If 
 Donald Trump says Deport / Deported / Deportation as part of midterm rally in Chillicothe, Ohio originally scheduled for October 28, 2026
, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
How this is resolved
Video of the midterm rally in Chillicothe, Ohio originally scheduled for October 28, 2026 using the live broadcast or stream.
If a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, internal & external (official) transcripts of the midterm rally in Chillicothe, Ohio originally scheduled for October 28, 2026 will be used.

Payout Criteria
The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word. 
Plural nouns occurring within proper nouns and noun phrases (e.g. names, titles, etc).
Donald Trump speaking in an official capacity.
For phrases with slashes like "Doge/Dogecoin," either word satisfies the criterion.

Doesn't count for payout
Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. 
Presence alone during a livestream is not sufficient for the market to qualify (e.g., inaudible private conversations on camera, unofficial statements picked up on a hot mic).
Except as otherwise specified, previously aired content, archival footage, and recordings captured at times, places, or events wholly separate from the featured address.

Payout for cancellations and delays
If an event is definitively cancelled or the event fails to qualify under the Payout Criterion, or any other circumstance prevents normal resolution, then the market for "Event does not qualify" resolves to Yes and all other markets will resolve to No.  
If the event is postponed, and such a postponement is announced by the end of the following calendar day to be rescheduled to a time within 14 calendar days, the markets shall remain open.

blind.reasoning: Reports from the morning of October 28 confirm the Chillicothe midterm rally was scheduled for that evening, so the event very likely took place. Trump's long rally speeches almost always cover immigration, and in his second term he routinely talks about deporting criminals, so at least one qualifying word ('deport', 'deported', 'deportation(s)') is more likely than not. Lowering the odds: the speech may focus on the local economy and candidates, he may say 'removed' or 'deporting' instead (neither counts), and there is a small chance of cancellation.
blind.falsifier: A full transcript or video of the Chillicothe rally showing Trump never said 'deport', 'deported', or 'deportation(s)', for example if he covered immigration only with words like 'removed' or 'deporting', or if the rally was cancelled.

final.reasoning: The market at 0.29 likely reflects better data on how often Trump has used these exact words in recent rallies, so I moved most of the way from 0.72 toward it. The remaining edge is small and rests on my weaker prior, so I'm passing.
